description: parse.rs resolve_args collects all #-key resolutions in phase 1 without modifying args, then applies all mutations atomically in phase 2. This correctly implements RFC 8620 §3.7's requirement that args is either fully resolved or unchanged — partial resolution would leave args in an inconsistent state that subsequent code could not distinguish from a valid partial args object. A contributor might suggest doing both phases in one pass for simplicity; this should be defended because one-pass mutation-during-iteration would require Clone of the args object or unsafe borrow patterns.
title: resolve_args two-phase atomic design is correct for ResultReference
